title: Tart Pineapple Crumble
description: A sweet and tangy French-inspired dessert featuring a buttery tart crust, a pineapple filling, and a crunchy oat topping.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt. Add the cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture into the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, mix together the pineapple chunks and tart jam.
Arrange the pineapple mixture over the tart crust, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
In another bowl, mix together the oats, brown sugar, and a pinch of salt.
Add the oat mixture to the top of the pineapple filling, spreading it evenly to cover the entire surface.
Bake the tart for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the topping is crispy.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, topped with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream if desired.
